info.name: BookSphere - Borrow Service
info.description: Postman collection for BS-BE-06 Borrow Service & Saga Pattern. Run the folders from top to bottom. Public Borrow APIs are called through API Gateway with JWT. Internal and header-validation probes call Borrow Service directly. Manual probes cover branches that require prepared DB state or intentionally stopped downstream services.

item.name: 05 - Scheduler & Manual Branch Probes
item.description: These requests help cover branches that require external setup: overdue DB rows, due-soon DB rows, stopped Book Service, or a late-return borrow. Run individually after preparing the described state.

item.name: Verify overdue scheduler output -> OVERDUE list

request.description: Before running: ensure at least one DBBorrow row has status BORROWING and due_date < now, then wait for BORROW_OVERDUE_SCHEDULER_FIXED_DELAY_MS. Fine/Notification may fail best-effort without failing Borrow status.

exec: pm.test("overdue count reaches expected minimum", function () { pm.expect(json.data.content.length).to.be.at.least(expected); });

item.name: Verify due-soon candidate list -> BORROWING list

request.description: Before running: ensure a BORROWING row has due_date within BORROW_DUE_SOON_WINDOW_HOURS. Verify Notification Service receives/keeps idempotent BORROW_DUE_SOON_{borrowId} if Notification Service is implemented.

request.description: Prepare lateReturnBorrowId with status BORROWING or OVERDUE and due_date before lateReturnDate. Expected: Borrow still RETURNED even if Fine/Notification internal APIs are not ready.
